integrity: All mathematical assertions are tied to a complete recursive enumeration and an executable exact directed refinement. The self-review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Complete through seven vertices only; no claims for larger orders. Theorem 6.29 of Kiefer already gives a broad individual-identification criterion; novelty is restricted to complete finite class multiplicities and explicit code strata, with residual risk of an older unlocated tabulation.
title: First two ambiguity layers of directed colour refinement on finite tournaments
